items.exampleEn: The new play by this dramatist opens next month in London.
items.exampleZh: 這位劇作家的新戲下個月在倫敦首演。

items.exampleEn: The impersonator dressed exactly like a famous rock star.
items.exampleZh: 那位模仿藝人打扮得跟一位知名搖滾明星一模一樣。

items.exampleEn: The fiddler at the wedding played until midnight.
items.exampleZh: 婚禮上那位提琴手一直拉到半夜。

items.exampleEn: Grandma told us a Japanese folktale about a magic fish.
items.exampleZh: 奶奶跟我們講了一個關於神奇魚的日本民間故事。

items.exampleEn: After all the excitement, the final announcement felt anticlimactic.
items.exampleZh: 大家興奮了半天，最後的宣佈卻讓人覺得掃興。
items.glossZh: 虎頭蛇尾的；令人掃興的

items.exampleEn: She preferred to be called a poet, not a poetess.
items.exampleZh: 她比較希望人家稱她為詩人，而不是「女詩人」。
items.glossZh: 女詩人（舊稱，現多用 poet）

items.exampleEn: I am so unmusical that I can't even sing in tune.
items.exampleZh: 我完全不懂音樂，連唱歌都會走音。

items.exampleEn: The old bells rang unmusically across the valley.
items.exampleZh: 那些舊鐘在山谷間響著，聲音很不和諧。

items.sentenceEn: Every culture has a folktale about a clever animal.
items.sentenceZh: 每個文化都有關於聰明動物的民間故事。

items.audioEn: The ending of the match was anticlimactic; it was stopped early because of rain.
items.audioZh: 比賽的結局很掃興，因為下雨而提早中止了。
options: Our team won it at the end.

items.sentenceEn: He became a fiddler in a small folk band after college.
items.sentenceZh: 他大學畢業後，成了一個小型民謠樂團的提琴手。

items.sentenceEn: Even an unmusical person can enjoy a good concert.
items.sentenceZh: 就算是不懂音樂的人，也能欣賞一場好的音樂會。

items.stemEn: Shakespeare is often called England's most famous ____.
items.stemZh: 莎士比亞常被稱為英國最有名的劇作家。

items.stemEn: The comedian is a skilled ____ who can copy the voices of many famous people.
items.stemZh: 那位喜劇演員是技巧高超的模仿藝人，能模仿許多名人的聲音。

items.passageEn: Every autumn, our village holds a festival of old stories. This year, a local dramatist turned an old folktale about a fox and a farmer into a short play. The stage was set against the silhouette of the hills. Before the play began, an elderly poetess, as she likes to call herself, read some of her poems about the sea. A fiddler played between the scenes, although one of his strings broke and he finished the last song rather unmusically. The ending felt a little anticlimactic, because the fox simply walked away. Still, the highlight of the evening was an impersonator who copied the voices of famous singers.
items.passageZh: 我們村子每年秋天都會舉辦一個說古老故事的節慶。今年，一位在地劇作家把一則關於狐狸和農夫的古老民間故事改編成短劇。舞台以山丘的剪影為背景。戲開演前，一位年長的女詩人（她喜歡這樣稱呼自己）朗讀了幾首關於大海的詩。一位提琴手在換場時演奏，不過他斷了一根弦，最後一首曲子拉得不太好聽。結局有點虎頭蛇尾，因為狐狸就這樣走掉了。儘管如此，當晚的亮點是一位模仿藝人，他模仿了好幾位知名歌手的聲音。

questions.questionZh: 這齣短劇是根據什麼改編的？
結局為什麼讓人有點掃興？
options: 演員忘了台詞而停下來
農夫最後和狐狸成了好朋友
大雨讓表演提早結束了

items.promptZh: 她是十九世紀一位很有名的女詩人。
referenceEn: She was a famous poetess in the nineteenth century.
She was a well-known poetess of the nineteenth century.
rubricZh: poetess 是「女詩人」的舊稱，現多用 poet；兩種寫法都收
時態配合內容（例如 was、is remembered as 等）
「十九世紀」可寫，例如 in the nineteenth century、of the nineteenth century 等

items.promptZh: 那隻鸚鵡的叫聲又大又不悅耳。
referenceEn: The parrot's cry is loud and unmusical.
That parrot has a loud, unmusical voice.
rubricZh: 「不悅耳」用 unmusical（例如 loud and unmusical、an unmusical voice 等）
時態配合內容（例如 is、was 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：跟讀「I am completely unmusical; I can't even clap in time.」與單字卡例句「I am so unmusical that I can't even sing in tune.」主詞（I）、情境（自己沒音樂細胞）相同，只換了句型，違反 §11-4 三項至少換兩項。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 跟讀改 Even an unmusical person can enjoy a good concert.（主詞、句型、情境都換）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：造句參考答案「My father is so unmusical that he can't tell two songs apart.」與單字卡例句同句型（so unmusical that … can't …）同情境，只換主詞，違反 §11-4。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 參考答案改 Nobody in my family is unmusical; we all play an instrument.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 A：跟讀與 fiddler 卡雷同（fiddler played＋地點）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改 He became a fiddler in a small folk band after college.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：poetess 是「女詩人」的舊稱，現多用 poet；兩種寫法都收／時態配合內容（例如 was、is remembered as 等）／「十九世紀」可寫，例如 in the nineteenth century、of the nineteenth century 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：unmusical 表示「不懂音樂的、沒有音樂細胞的」（例如 so unmusical that…、was unmusical 等）／句子要說到你自己或家人／時態配合內容（例如 is、used to think 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（unmusical）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u15-l03-q17；目標字沿用 unmusical
